what: Controls for scripts/ablate_learned_model.py -- the rule 3 counterfactual. A1 and A2 hand the harness a perfect ranking and a perfectly wrong one, so 'the no-ML gate scored badly' can be told apart from 'the scorer scores everything badly'. A7 is run in the direction that hurts this project.

controls.name: A1 oracle auc
controls.expects: a perfect ranking scores AUC 1.0

controls.name: A1 oracle gate
controls.expects: a perfect ranking forwards 1840 documents with 0 leaks

controls.name: A2 anti-oracle auc
controls.expects: a perfectly wrong ranking scores AUC 0.0

controls.name: A2 anti-oracle gate
controls.expects: a perfectly wrong ranking forwards every leaker first

controls.name: A3 base rate
controls.expects: arm S base leak rate reproduces gate_eval.json (0.1003)

controls.name: A3 base rate control
controls.expects: a perturbed base rate must NOT match

controls.name: A3 auc
controls.expects:
arm S ranking AUC reproduces posterior_ablation.json AND
      gate_eval.json (0.7498)

controls.name: A3 leak rate
controls.expects: arm S leak rate at coverage 0.6365 reproduces posterior_ablation.json (0.0467)

controls.name: A3 auc control
controls.expects: a perturbed AUC must NOT match

controls.name: A3 documents
controls.expects: all three arms score the same 2891 documents

controls.name: A4 unmasked
controls.expects: with no spans, every surviving count is positive

controls.name: A4 fully masked
controls.expects: with the whole document spanned, every surviving count is 0

controls.name: A4 span count
controls.expects: spans_redacted counts the spans it was given

controls.name: A4 statistic set
controls.expects: exactly 6 no-ML statistics are computed

controls.name: A5 leak fires
controls.expects: an annotated identifier left in the clear is a leak

controls.name: A5 leak clears
controls.expects: the same identifier, covered, is not a leak

controls.name: A5 partial
controls.expects: half-covering an identifier is still a leak

controls.name: A6 exact k
controls.expects: leak_rate_at_coverage scores exactly k documents

controls.name: A6 budget stop
controls.expects: max_coverage_within_exposure stops before exceeding the budget

controls.name: A6 budget zero
controls.expects: a budget of 0 leaking documents stops at the first leaker

controls.name: A6 budget all
controls.expects: a budget larger than the corpus forwards everything

controls.name: A7 sign flip
controls.expects: the picker chooses the NEGATED form of an anti-correlated statistic

controls.name: A7 twelve candidates
controls.expects: twelve candidates are scored -- six statistics, both signs

controls.name: A7 picks the max
controls.expects: the chosen candidate has the highest AUC of the twelve

controls.name: A8 labels move
controls.expects: arm B's base leak rate differs from arm S's -- a leak is defined against the redaction that arm performed

controls.name: A8 labels held
controls.expects: arm R redacts identically to arm S, so its base rate is identical

controls.name: A9 best of twelve (B_no_learned_model)
controls.expects: the reported statistic is the highest-AUC candidate in its own table

controls.name: A9 arm auc matches (B_no_learned_model)
controls.expects: the arm's headline AUC is the chosen candidate's AUC

controls.name: A9 best of twelve (R_redaction_api)
controls.expects: the reported statistic is the highest-AUC candidate in its own table

controls.name: A9 arm auc matches (R_redaction_api)
controls.expects: the arm's headline AUC is the chosen candidate's AUC
